metadata.description: Claude Code plugins maintained by Contract Hero — Sui Move tooling and developer-experience extensions.

plugins.name: sui-pilot
plugins.description: Sui Move development plugin — 753 bundled docs, Move LSP integration, Sui Prover formal verification, and five specialized skills (code quality, security review, math safety, formal specs, verification).

plugins.name: codex-bridge
plugins.description: Bridge to OpenAI Codex CLI — /codex execution and /claudex multi-round prompt refinement.

plugins.name: code-forge
plugins.description: Multi-agent build system with TDD-as-phase, script-coordinated parallel review, best-of-N implementer, and forge-guard hook discipline.

plugins.name: agentic-community-college
plugins.description: Claude Code learning framework that runs reference-seeded coding lessons through MCP. Ships course-engine + course-conductor + course-creator + lesson-creator skills and a declarative probe runtime. Pair with any acc-content plugin (e.g. acc-deepbook-course) to teach a domain.

plugins.name: acc-deepbook-course
plugins.description: DeepBook content for the Agentic Community College (ACC) framework — bundles hands-on lessons that walk learners through building Sui DeepBook integrations end-to-end. Requires the agentic-community-college plugin to run.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Self-contained HTML deliverable toolkit — bundles html-artifact (one-off visual deliverables), publish-html (turn a local .html into a shareable URL), for-dummies (auto-derived project intros), and move-call-chains (HTML call-chain diagrams for Sui Move packages). Used by agentic-community-college's claude-plugin-enabled probe.

plugins.name: acc-evm-wal
plugins.description: ACC content plugin teaching the basics of Walrus decentralized storage and how to integrate it with Solidity smart contracts. Ships one short Foundry-based lesson (offline-runnable) that walks learners through building a WalrusAnchor contract end-to-end. Requires the agentic-community-college plugin to run.

plugins.name: sui-agent-tank
plugins.description: Guided evaluation harness — grade a Sui-stack context bundle (a skill folder or a Claude Code plugin) by GitHub URL. /tank clones it, auto-detects the kind, runs a containerized agent through compile/test gates + Move anti-pattern traps + a cross-model judge, and reports.
